note.summary:
1.1 Identity and relationships with others
Key focus
- family, friendship, personality and healthy relationships.

Core language
- Useful structures: मेरे विचार में; मुझे ... पसंद है क्योंकि; पिछले साल; अगली बार; आम तौर पर; मुझे ... चाहिए।
- Nouns and adjectives agree in gender and number; use present, past and future time markers consistently.

Exam tips
- For comprehension, locate the exact word or phrase that proves each answer.
- In translation, preserve tense, negatives, quantities and relationships between people.
- In writing, add opinions and reasons, vary time frames, and check verb and adjective agreement.

questions.examTip: Use correct word order, postpositions (को, में, से, का/की/के) and verb agreement; place the main verb at the end.
questions.modelAnswer: मेरे परिवार में चार लोग हैं: माता-पिता, मेरी छोटी बहन और मैं।
questions.question:
Translate into Hindi:

There are four people in my family: my parents, my younger sister and me.

questions.examTip: Use correct word order, postpositions (को, में, से, का/की/के) and verb agreement; place the main verb at the end.
questions.modelAnswer: मेरी माँ हमेशा मेरी बात सुनती हैं, इसलिए हमारी बहुत अच्छी बनती है।
questions.question:
Translate into Hindi:

My mother always listens to me, so we get on very well.

questions.examTip: Use correct word order, postpositions (को, में, से, का/की/के) and verb agreement; place the main verb at the end.
questions.modelAnswer: मेरा सबसे अच्छा दोस्त भरोसेमंद है, लेकिन कभी-कभी ज़िद्दी होता है।
questions.question:
Translate into Hindi:

My best friend is reliable, but sometimes he is stubborn.

questions.examTip: Use correct word order, postpositions (को, में, से, का/की/के) and verb agreement; place the main verb at the end.
questions.modelAnswer: पिछले रविवार को कंप्यूटर के कारण मेरा अपने भाई से झगड़ा हुआ।
questions.question:
Translate into Hindi:

Last Sunday I argued with my brother because of the computer.

questions.examTip: Use correct word order, postpositions (को, में, से, का/की/के) and verb agreement; place the main verb at the end.
questions.modelAnswer: हमने जल्द ही माफ़ी माँगी और फिर से दोस्त बन गए।
questions.question:
Translate into Hindi:

We soon apologised and became friends again.

questions.examTip: Use correct word order, postpositions (को, में, से, का/की/के) and verb agreement; place the main verb at the end.
questions.modelAnswer: मेरे विचार में दोस्त में ईमानदारी सबसे ज़रूरी गुण है।
questions.question:
Translate into Hindi:

In my opinion, honesty is the most important quality in a friend.

questions.examTip: Cover every bullet, use past and future forms where relevant, and justify opinions with क्योंकि.
questions.modelAnswer:
मेरे परिवार में चार लोग हैं: माता-पिता, मेरी छोटी बहन और मैं। मेरी माँ हमेशा मेरी बात सुनती हैं, इसलिए हमारी बहुत अच्छी बनती है। मेरा सबसे अच्छा दोस्त भरोसेमंद है, लेकिन कभी-कभी ज़िद्दी होता है। मेरे विचार में यह महत्वपूर्ण है और भविष्य में मैं एक नया अनुभव लेना चाहूँगा।

(English translation: There are four people in my family: my parents, my younger sister and me. My mother always listens to me, so we get on very well. My best friend is reliable, but sometimes he is stubborn. In my opinion it is important, and in the future I would like to have a new experience.)
